case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70530.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
sup:70530.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
message.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Our forecast for Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 rises 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).

On our order history with you:
Our orders of Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 with you were placed at EUR 414.61 on 2024-10-14 (po:4500011548-10), EUR 400.19 on 2025-06-30 (po:4500012634-10), EUR 412.74 on 2026-01-27 (po:4500013491-10) and EUR 412.74 on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014465-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 418.79; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 416.33; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 415.11; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Binding volume in every option: 4,580 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Selvbrunn the longest commitment and a binding volume across the full term, while the price stays where our recent orders have been placed. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As this goes beyond what you may decide alone, we ask you to take Option A to your pricing committee. We are glad to provide whatever the committee needs for its approval.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
message.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We have reviewed your verified order history and forecast increase, which allows us to adjust our position. We are prepared to accept the 24-month contract term and 45-day payment target as outlined in your Option C. In conjunction with these terms, we propose a revised unit price of EUR 429.43. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €431.63 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €429.43 per unit, a price of €429.43 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have presented your Option A to our management committee as requested. The committee has confirmed that the strict freeze on price reductions until December 2027 remains fully in effect.

Consequently, we must maintain our offer of a price of €431.63 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, and a contract term of 24 months.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

You told us your committee has confirmed the freeze on price reductions and that your price follows your main cost drivers. Our options answer that with what a committee can plan on: a binding volume over a fixed contract term, in every option.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Selvbrunn the longest payment term together with the full binding volume across the whole contract, which is the planning certainty a committee needs to sign off.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 423.87; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 421.38; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 420.15; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Binding volume in every option: 4,580 units a year over 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Please take Option A to the committee, and tell us if the approval needs anything more from us.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
